id: rf-groups-lie-in-derived-subgroups-of-rf-groups
kind: claim
title: Every finitely generated residually finite (resp. LEF) group embeds in the derived subgroup of a finitely generated residually finite (resp. LEF) group
distinct_from:
  fp-group-embeds-in-fp-derived-subgroup: that keeps finite presentability; this keeps residual finiteness or LEF, through products or ultraproducts of finite symmetric groups.
---

**ESTABLISHED (unreviewed).** Let `Γ` be generated by a finite set `S`.
1. If `Γ` is residually finite, there are a finitely generated residually finite group `Δ` and an injective
   homomorphism `ρ : Γ -> Δ` with `ρ(Γ) ≤ [Δ,Δ]`; every `ρ(s)`, `s ∈ S`, is a single commutator. If `Γ` is infinite,
   so is `Δ`.
2. If `Γ` is LEF, the same holds with `Δ` LEF.

**Application.** `rf-groups-embed-in-simple-kazhdan-lef-groups`. There a copy of the acting group inside a unit group
must consist of commutators to reach the elementary group, since the shift unit itself is not elementary
(`shift-unit-of-subshift-crossed-product-is-not-elementary`).

Route: `rf-groups-lie-in-derived-subgroups-of-rf-groups-proof`.
